title: Turn on HTTPS Inspection on the gateway (+ optional inspect rule)

manual_steps: SmartConsole > {gateway} > HTTPS Inspection > Step 3: select Enable HTTPS Inspection (Deployment Mode: Full inspection)
Publish, then install the Access Control policy

steps.describe: Host object {client_host_name} ({client_ip}) so the rule only affects this computer

payload.name: {client_host_name}
payload.comments: Created by AI Guard Demo Kit

conflict_fix: Rename or delete the existing host {client_host_name} in SmartConsole (Objects > Object Explorer)
Or limit the rule to another object: --scope <object name> (or --scope any)
manual_steps: SmartConsole > Objects > New > Host: name {client_host_name}, IPv4 address {client_ip}, comment "Created by AI Guard Demo Kit"

steps.describe: HTTPS Inspection rule "{https_rule_name}" at the top of {https_layer}: inspect traffic from {protected_scope}

manual_steps: SmartConsole > Security Policies > HTTPS Inspection > {https_layer}: add a rule at the top named "{https_rule_name}"
Source {protected_scope}, Destination Any, Services Any, Action Inspect, Track {https_track}, Install On {gateway}
